`archive.json` contains 26 cases generated by the adjacent `archive_generate.py`
using installed gallery-dl 1.32.17's actual MetadataPP constructor/run and archive
check/add/close. It records SQLite tables/entries, cached keys, hook registration,
writer outcomes, and physical connection reuse/pragma behavior. Source SHA-256
values are embedded. All identities are synthetic; no network is used. `$WORK`
replaces the temporary directory. String archive paths retain upstream CWD
semantics. The minimal path adapter supplies an existing filename/directory;
array path generation is tested separately in the Rust engine.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```
/private/tmp/gdlvenv/bin/python tests/fixtures/postprocessors/archive_generate.py tests/fixtures/postprocessors/archive.json
```

Default format/prefix, explicit/empty prefix, explicit/empty/quoted table names,
cache mutation, JSON/tags/custom/JSONL, skip-existing, empty content, render/write
failure, metadata-path overwriting the cached key, modify/delete/stdout bypass,
file archive mode, and first-connection pragma reuse are genuine source outputs.
The Rust engine tests replay key/cache/schema cases and open a source-compatible
SQLite table directly; the parent runtime tests cover writer hook integration.
